children.value: > Fact From Story: The highly anticipated criminal trial for Sam Bankman-Fried, former CEO of bankrupt crypto exchange FTX, started Tuesday to determine whether he’s guilty of seven counts of fraud and conspiracy.
> > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried faces seven federal charges, including wire fraud, securities fraud and money laundering, that could put him in prison for the rest of his life.
> > > Fact From Story: FTX spiraled into bankruptcy in November.
> > > Fact From Story: Bankman-Fried co-founded FTX in 2019.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: People are put on trial when they are suspected of committing crimes.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Wire fraud, securities fraud and money laundering are crimes.
> Commonsense Knowledge: A trial determines whether or not someone is guilty of a crime.
